title: Verify: Admin execution routes reject missing and wrong tokens unit tests
summary: Server-level tests that all eight admin routes, including retry and approve, reject missing and wrong tokens.
description: Walk the real router and the route table to prove every admin route is protected and listed.
acceptance_criteria: All eight admin routes return 401 for missing and wrong tokens.
retry and approve with 'Bearer tok' are not 401.
Every /api/v1/admin route in the chi router is in adminRoutes.

steps.action: Build server with token 'tok'. For each route in adminRoutes(&execution.Handler{}, &admin.RoundHandler{}) with {id} replaced by ID-1, assert 401 with no header and with 'Bearer wrong'; assert not 401 with 'Bearer tok' for POST /executions/ID-1/retry and /approve.
steps.expected: All 8 routes yield 401 unauthenticated; retry and approve are not 401 with tok.

steps.action: Type-assert New(cfg, log) to chi.Routes, chi.Walk it collecting method+route for routes starting with /api/v1/admin, and assert the set equals adminRoutes entries prefixed with /api/v1/admin.
steps.expected: Walked routes equal the table; no unlisted admin route.
